en: Proverbs 30

p.src: 1  The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

ja: はイティエルに、 イティエルとウカルにこう
en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
u.src: 1  The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

p.src: 2  “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

ja: は誰よりも無知な者であり、
en: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
u.src: 2  “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

p.src: 3  I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

en: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
u.src: 3  I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

p.src: 4  Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

en: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
u.src: 4  Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

p.src: 5  “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

en: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
u.src: 5  “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

p.src: 6  Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

ja: えてはならない。 さもないと、
en: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
u.src: 6  Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

p.src: 7  “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

en: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
u.src: 7  “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

p.src: 8  Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

ja: しさも富も私に与えず、
en: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
u.src: 8  Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

p.src: 9  lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

ja: うことのないように。 また、
en: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
u.src: 9  lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

p.src: 10  “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

ja: に中傷してはならない。 さもないと、
en: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
u.src: 10  “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

p.src: 11  There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

en: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
u.src: 11  There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

p.src: 12  There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

en: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
u.src: 12  There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

p.src: 13  There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

ja: ぶった目、 なんと上がったまぶたの
en: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
u.src: 13  There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

p.src: 14  There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

ja: のようで、 あごが刃物のような
en: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
u.src: 14  There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

p.src: 15  “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

ja: がいて、 『くれ、くれ』と言う。 決して
en: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:
u.src: 15  “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

p.src: 16  Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

ja: よみ、 子を産まない
en: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’
u.src: 16  Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

ja: 30:16 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 30:16 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 17  “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

ja: のからすにえぐり取られ、
en: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
u.src: 17  “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

p.src: 18  “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

ja: にとって驚くべきことが
に理解できないことが
en: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
u.src: 18  “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

p.src: 19  The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

en: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
u.src: 19  The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

p.src: 20  “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

ja: いことをしていない』と
en: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
u.src: 20  “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

p.src: 21  “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

ja: つのことによって地は震え、 四つのことには
en: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:
u.src: 21  “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

p.src: 22  For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

en: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
u.src: 22  For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

p.src: 23  for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

en: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.
u.src: 23  for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

p.src: 24  “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

ja: さいが、 この上なく知恵あるものが
en: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
u.src: 24  “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

p.src: 25  The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

en: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
u.src: 25  The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

p.src: 26  The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

en: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
u.src: 26  The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

p.src: 27  The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

en: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
u.src: 27  The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

p.src: 28  You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

en: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
u.src: 28  You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

p.src: 29  “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

ja: つあり、 堂々と進むものが
en: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
u.src: 29  “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

p.src: 30  The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

en: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
u.src: 30  The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

p.src: 31  the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

ja: やぎ、 そして誰も立ち向かえない
en: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
u.src: 31  the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

p.src: 32  “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

ja: くして愚かなことをしたなら、 また、
en: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
u.src: 32  “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

p.src: 33  For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

en: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
u.src: 33  For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
